snippet.title: FIVE NIGHTS AT WARIO'S 2 (Trailer + DOWNLOAD)
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: http://gamejolt.com/games/strategy-sim/five-nights-at-wario-s-2/48455/

Dawko's Games: https://www.youtube.com/user/dawkosgames

►SUBSCRIBE: http://bit.ly/1a4jDdO
►TWITTER: http://bit.ly/MnH866
►MUSHROOM KINGDOM SHOWDOWN WIKI: http://mushroom-kingdom-showdown.wikia.com/

The sequel is finally here! This is a fan-game of Scott Cawthon's amazing franchise Five Nights at Freddy's! I'm a huge fan of the series, as well as Wario, so that's why I'm making this! ^^ Hope you'll like it, and make sure to spread the word of this game wherever you can!! :)

Thank you for the GREAT support!
